title: Keep a worker pool stable under sustained load
description: Run eight one-second windows. New work arrives, workers complete an exact integer capacity, and the selected policy handles every remaining task.

policies.label: Block the producer
policies.detail: Keep the worker queue bounded and hold overflow upstream for the next window.

policies.label: Reject new overflow
policies.detail: Keep memory bounded and return an explicit admission failure for work that does not fit.

policies.label: Allow an unbounded queue
policies.detail: Admit every task and retain unfinished work without a configured queue limit.
